meta.summit_headline: Research is where judgement is tested.
meta.summit_standfirst: Summit’s research examines how luxury acquires authority, how institutions preserve it, and what happens when time, governance, desire and stewardship pull in different directions.
The Mystery of Luxury — by Gregory Gray and Olivia Dhordain.
meta.summit_summary: The Mystery of Luxury. A book by Gregory Gray and Olivia Dhordain on when an object becomes meaning, and who keeps that meaning alive.
